copy.default: A native home for your agents.

spec.why-raw: The available registry contains React control implementations, not GNOME, AppKit, or WinUI widgets. This is a browser-rendered visual study of native desktop surfaces, preserving registered interaction grammar and existing backend semantics.
spec.lifecycle: Resident in the signed-in desktop session from login. Each panel is summoned directly by a configurable global shortcut, with no foreground app launch and no independent Dock/taskbar/Alt-Tab entry. Escape dismisses, repeated shortcut toggles, and optional pinning retains context. Panels have no app minimize/maximize chrome. Only ordinary terminal windows retain application-window behavior. Mock shortcuts are browser-scoped simulations, not OS registration.
spec.goals: D-010: Goals and Work on everything are first-class context. Goals sidebar has a direct shortcut; search includes goals; terminal rails and chat carry selected-goal context; accounts show goal spend/cap without changing account-control scope; layouts can group by goal within each desktop. Reuse existing goal list/detail, ongoing-work-model, GoalWorkRail and WorkOnEverything controls, priority worklists, attention, outcomes and evidence. Standing-goal plan progress is not completion of the endless goal. Pause/resume/start reflect server-confirmed state and degraded-result warnings. All mock goal actions are previews and change no live goal.
spec.remote: Reuse psu saved profiles, connection selection, transports, and reattachment through the existing connection front controller. No new credential or remote transport store.
spec.agentActivation: Focus the exact existing terminal. Remote targets reuse the selected saved psu connection. No chat popup is opened by agent selection.
spec.terminalPanels: Orders on the left, Activity on the right, and optional Fleet peers. Compact states preserve terminal space.
spec.layouts: Arrange terminals and attached panels as a group; distinguish local viewer layouts from remote desktop layouts; preserve pinned windows and offer Undo.
spec.chat: Native presentation of existing conversation and card contracts. Simulated messages never leave the mockup.
spec.accounts: Preserve provider usage, session and week windows, Default fallback, Force eligible-pool restriction, and Exclude. Distinguish Auto routing from the default-account axis.
spec.samples: All account usage, identities, activity, and reset times are illustrative. No credentials are present.
